Well tracked: dominant arm >= 0.8 and dominant hand >= 0.5 of the piece's frames; a segment's piece widened to at least 0.2 s; the kind with more well-tracked clips serves a token. A rank without a source stays unsigned; nothing slides up. Vocabulary is train only; ASL Citizen, STEM Wiki, c00, test and held-out are refused.
